6bd0d98c4d.
(1) Deletions: a porcelain=v2 -z baseline (entry fields plus content hash) is captured before the launch and replaces the mtime filter. Deletes, new files and re-writes to already-dirty files are committed; untouched older dirt stays the host's.
(2) Rename/copy: both the destination and the source are committed. A path gone from the worktree is staged with git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch.
(3) Error exits: ChildStoreCommit is armed before the launch in run_standalone_reviewer and RealPhaseDriver::run_reviewer/run_implementer, and commits on drop, so an Err after the child ran still commits.
(4) Wiring tests drive the real run_standalone_reviewer (AIDA_AGENT_CMD mock) and RealPhaseDriver::run_reviewer (fake aida). The child deletes a lease and adds an object, the launcher takes its no-verdict Err exit, and the test asserts one launcher commit with D and A. Removing the arm from either launcher fails its test.
Gates: check-ci-fast 32/32, test-touched 222/0, check-ci-compile ok. 0 behind main.
Gap: the implementer path has no wiring test, because its BUG-2140 sweep masks a removed call; noted in the PR.
subject: PR-2777 ready (BUG-2185)
